dialogue.intro: Hi there! I'm Honey. I moved here to find a quiet little life... and someone to share it with. Maybe that's you?$h
gift.love: Oh! You know me so well... this means the world to me.
gift.like: Aww, that's so thoughtful of you!
gift.dislike: Hmm... I'll keep it somewhere safe.
gift.neutral: For me? Thank you, that's sweet.
dialogue.mon: Morning, @! When I first moved here, I didn't know a single soul. Then you came along.
dialogue.tue: I was scribbling in my journal down by the beach this morning. The sea has a way of making the words flow.
dialogue.wed: Have you tried the green tea at the Stardrop Saloon? It reminds me of home.
dialogue.thu: I keep thinking about the little things lately. Sunrises. Wildflowers. You.
dialogue.fri: The whole valley smells like honey and woodsmoke today. I love that.
dialogue.sat: If you ever get lonely, you know where to find me by the shore.
dialogue.sun: I'm almost done with a new chapter of my book. Maybe I'll let you read it... if you're nice.
dialogue.bday: It's my birthday! And you remembered... of course you did.$h
dialogue.acceptbouquet: Wait... really?@#$b#Yes. A thousand times yes.$l
dialogue.acceptgift: For me? You're always thinking of me.$h
dialogue.rejectbouquet: I'm sorry, @... it's a little too soon right now. Give me a bit more time.$s
dialogue.breakup: You gave me a wilted bouquet... Do you really mean this?$s
dialogue.divorced: I... I don't think I can talk to you right now.$s
dialogue.jealous: I saw you giving {0} a {1}... Are you sweet on them, @?$a
dialogue.rainy: On rainy days like this I like to sit by the window and write. The patter of the rain helps the words come.
marriage.rain0: I'm staying in to write today. You'd better come cuddle after dinner.$h
marriage.rain1: It's raining... the perfect day for a chapter or two. I left you some tea on the counter.
marriage.rain2: I've been re-reading our first letters to each other. You make me so happy.
marriage.rain3: The farm looks so peaceful in the rain. Stay home with me?
marriage.rain4: One year with you, and it already feels like a lifetime of lovely memories.
marriage.sun27: Happy our-iversary, you silly goose. I'd marry you all over again tomorrow.$l
marriage.indoor0: The house is quiet and you're warm. I have everything I need.
marriage.indoor1: I've been writing our story. All the little moments, every single one.
marriage.indoor2: Tonight I'm so grateful we found each other on that little farm.
marriage.rainynight0: Listen... rain against the windows, and us. This is exactly what I daydreamed about.
marriage.rainynight1: Stay close tonight. I don't want to miss a single second of this.
marriage.funleave: I'm off to my corner to write for a while. Don't wander too far!$h
marriage.funreturn: I'm back! I wrote three whole pages while you were out.$h
marriage.spouseroom: This little corner of the house is mine - it's where the magic happens. The book magic, I mean.
marriage.patio: Fresh air always sparks my imagination. It's so beautiful out here with you.
marriage.outdoor: I love our little farm. I love watching you work it even more.
marriage.good0: I was just thinking about the first time we met. Look how far we've come.$l
marriage.good1: That smile of yours... it still makes my heart skip a beat.
marriage.good2: Let's stay up late and just talk. I never get tired of your voice.
marriage.neutral0: I hope you're taking breaks out there. Come have some tea with me.
marriage.bad0: Talk to me when you can, okay? I miss you when you're out on the farm.
marriage.onekid0: One day we'll tell %kid1 the story of how we met. They'll never believe it.
marriage.twokids0: Our children are going to hear the best bedtime story in the whole valley.
marriage.stardrop: This is my heart, love. I've stored half of it with you.$l
marriage.nobed0: Did the bed disappear, or did we just fall asleep on the floor again?$s
marriage.afterwedding: Honey's here, married and in love. I've never been this happy.$l
engaged0: I can't stop smiling. I'm going to marry the love of my life!$h
engaged1: I've already started the first page of our wedding chapter.
engaged: Yes! A thousand times yes! I'll be counting the days until we're married, @.$l
events.intro.1: Oh! Hello, neighbor! I'm Honey. I moved into the valley a few weeks ago.
events.intro.2: I heard about the new farmer on Grandpa's farm and I was hoping I'd run into you.#$b#The valley can be a quiet place... but they say love grows best in the quiet.
events.intro.3: Anyway - there are fresh muffins waiting at my little corner of the shore someday soon. Consider yourself invited, @.$h
events.date1.1: I asked you to meet me by the sea because... the water always knows how to slow time down.
events.date1.2: You're so easy to talk to, @. It feels like we've known each other for years.#$b#Maybe a whole year, give or take a few months.$u
events.date1.3: Let's make this a habit. You know where to find me.$h
events.star.1: Look at all those stars... people say each one is a wish someone made.
events.star.2: I think I found mine already. It's standing right next to me.
events.star.3: You make ordinary evenings feel magical, @.$l
events.charm.1: I've been carrying this little jar of honey around for good luck.
events.charm.2: Here - lucky charms are meant to be shared. And honestly? I'd rather the luck always found you.
events.charm.3: And no - it's not my nickname, you silly. The sweet stuff just reminds me of you.$h
events.chapter.1: I've been writing a story. It's about a girl who moves somewhere new and finds the person who makes her feel like home.
events.chapter.2: I finished the first chapter, and it kept reminding me of you... because you're in it.#$b#Tonight, that chapter is waiting in your mailbox. Page one of us.
events.chapter.3: Read it slowly, okay? I wrote it like a love letter.$h
events.love.1: A year. We've been here a year, you and me.
events.love.2: I can't imagine doing any of this - the farming, the seasons, the quiet nights - with anyone else.
events.love.3: When you're ready... there's something old and blue by the sea, waiting to be asked.$l
events.after.1: Here we are... husband and wife, on our little farm, one year in.
events.after.2: I promise to keep writing our story, for every single year we get together.#$b#Starting with this chapter: us, a porch, and the whole valley asleep.
events.after.3: Happy anniversary, my love. Here's to forever.$l
mail.intro: Dear @,^   I saw you out by the farm today and I haven't stopped smiling since. If the bell ever rings at my little corner of the valley, it'll be me.^~ Honey
mail.date1: Dear @,^   Same time, same shore? This afternoon was my favorite part of the week.^~ H
mail.star: Dear @,^   Last night I came home and wrote down everything you said. It's the first page of a book I'm going to call ours.^~ Your Honey
mail.charm: Dear @,^   I hope you're keeping that little jar of honey out of trouble. It kept me company for a long time; now it belongs with you.^~ Me
mail.chapter: Dear @,^   Enclosed: chapter one. It begins, 'She came to the valley on a promise, and found a person who became her home.'^   I meant every word.^~ Your author
mail.ring: Dear @,^   The old fisherman by the sea knows about the blue thing I mentioned. Ask him when you're ready. But don't be gone too long... I'd miss you.^~ Your Honey
